Dec 14, 2022

Image 29: Rated 2 out of 5 stars

## Disappointed
Disappointed. Bought the vegan and vegan active powder pouches a month ago and have found the texture to be the main issue. There's tiny bits (I'm guessing walnut?) of solid food that if you don't chew hit the back of your throat as you drink - the active seems better than standard, but the texture is still not great. Also found I always end up with a tiny amount of wet powder congealed at the bottom of the shaker.  
  
On the plus side the flavour is neutral, great ingredients and it does fill you up for some time. I recommend using it in a blender rather than just shaking. (It's also frustrating the high cost of minimum order for the UK.) For the price I expected better.

results.title: BestRand: Benchmark Compression Cuts High-Error Risk 50.2% | explainx.ai Blog | explainx.ai
results.content:
## Bottom line

BestRand is a small, practical idea backed by a theory about why random sampling works and where it breaks. If you run model evaluations regularly, it is worth an afternoon with the quick preset. If you only read benchmark tables, the lesson is simpler: a smaller test can be a good estimate, but a single unlucky sample can mislead, and the people reporting the number should say how the subset was chosen.

Details such as repository contents and reported numbers are accurate as of November 6, 2026, and may change as the authors update the paper or code.

## Related reading [...] ·10 min read·Yash Thakker

add explainx.ai
go deep

BestRand is a way to evaluate AI models on a small slice of a benchmark and still land close to the full-benchmark score. The paper, Random Is Almost Enough? Stable and Low-Cost Benchmark Compression via BestRand, argues that plain random sampling already works "surprisingly" well, but fails badly on rare draws. BestRand keeps the cheap random idea and trims those bad draws. The authors report a 50.2% drop in high-error risk and a 16.4% drop in estimation error against competing methods, at 51.3% of their construction cost.
